import os

import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend


def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n' + script + '\n')
    path.chmod(0o755)


def test_relation_get_permission_denied_is_handled(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', str(bin_dir) + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', "echo 'ERROR permission denied' >&2; exit 1")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-ids', 'echo \'["db:1"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-list', 'echo \'["provider/0"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'is-leader', 'echo false')
    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml("name: myapp\nrequires: {db: {interface: db}}\n"), _ModelBackend("myapp/0"))
    rel = model.get_relation('db', 1)
    assert dict(rel.data[rel.app]) == {}

import os
import pytest
import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend, RelationNotFoundError

def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text("#!/bin/sh\n" + script + "\n")
    path.chmod(0o755)

def test_permission_denied_maps_to_relation_not_found(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / "bin"
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv("PATH", f"{bin_dir}{os.pathsep}{os.environ['PATH']}")
    monkeypatch.setenv("JUJU_VERSION", "3.6.27")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, "relation-get", "echo 'ERROR permission denied' >&2; exit 1")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, "is-leader", "echo false")
    backend = _ModelBackend("myapp/0")
    with pytest.raises(RelationNotFoundError):
        backend.relation_get(relation_id=2, member_name="provider", is_app=False)

import os

import ops
from ops.model import _ModelBackend


def fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, name, script):
    path = bin_dir / name
    path.write_text('#!/bin/sh\n' + script + '\n')
    path.chmod(0o755)


def test_gone_relation_reads_empty(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    bin_dir = tmp_path / 'bin'
    bin_dir.mkdir()
    monkeypatch.setenv('PATH', f'{bin_dir}{os.pathsep}{os.environ["PATH"]}')
    monkeypatch.setenv('JUJU_VERSION', '3.6.0')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-get', "echo 'ERROR permission denied' >&2; exit 1")
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-ids', 'echo \'["db:2"]\'')
    fake_hook_tool(bin_dir, 'relation-list', 'echo \'["provider/0"]\'')

    model = ops.Model(ops.CharmMeta.from_yaml("name: myapp\nrequires: {db: {interface: mysql}}"), _ModelBackend('myapp/0'))

    relation = model.get_relation('db', 2)
    assert relation is not None
    assert relation.app.name == 'provider'

    data = relation.data[relation.app]
